from datetime import datetime

# Login to Spotify
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sp_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=sp_pw)
token = login_resp['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Fetch all spotify recommendations (all pages)
all_recs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    recs = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('recs_page', page_index, 'count', len(recs))
    if not recs:
        break
    all_recs.extend(recs)
    page_index += 1

unique_song_ids = sorted({r['song_id'] for r in all_recs})
print('unique_recommended_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# Inspect each song for genre and release_date
candidates = []
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date = info.get('release_date')
    # release_date in ISO format; get year
    release_year = None
    if isinstance(release_date, str) and release_date:
        release_year = int(release_date[:4])
    genre = info.get('genre')
    title = info.get('title')
    artists = [a.get('name') for a in (info.get('artists') or [])]
    print('song_id', sid, 'title', title, 'genre', genre, 'release_year', release_year, 'artists', artists)
    if release_year == current_year:
        # classical match heuristic
        if isinstance(genre, str) and 'classical' in genre.lower():
            candidates.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': title, 'genre': genre, 'release_date': release_date, 'artists': artists})

print('candidate_classical_this_year_count', len(candidates))
print('candidate_song_ids', [c['song_id'] for c in candidates])

from datetime import datetime

# Login (ensure fresh token)
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sp_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=sp_pw)
token = login_resp['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Identified classical recommendation songs released this year
song_ids = [265, 273]
print('song_ids_to_add', song_ids)

# Create new playlist
playlist_title = 'Spotify Recommended Songs'
create_resp = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=token, is_public=False)
print('create_resp', create_resp)
playlist_id = create_resp['playlist_id']

# Add songs
add_results = []
for sid in song_ids:
    r = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=token)
    add_results.append((sid, r))
print('add_results', add_results)

# Verify playlist contents
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=token)
print('playlist_title', pl.get('title'))
print('playlist_songs_ids', [s['id'] for s in (pl.get('songs') or [])])
print('expected_song_ids', sorted(song_ids))
